rationale: Describes virtualized load-balancer deployment across public and private cloud/virtual-machine environments, a conventional infrastructure deployment function.
evidence_spans: KEMP Virtual LoadMaster (VLM) is a virtualized edition of LoadMaster that can be deployed in the Cloud from Azure or AWS marketplaces (including the Government specific regions); in a virtual machine in any Cloud providers VMs; on private virtual infrastructures such as that from VMware, Hyper-V, VirtualBox, and Xen. VLM is ideal for use with IoT Platforms and infrastructure.
